title: Electric Scooter Guided Tour of Quebec City
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Québec City's Hidden Neighborhoods! 

Hop on an electric scooter for an exhilarating ride through the vibrant neighborhoods of Saint-Roch, Limoilou, and Saint-Sauveur, where Québec residents live, work, and play. Feel the breeze as you zip along the scenic Saint-Charles River path, gliding effortlessly through charming streets and hidden corners of the city. This is the perfect way to explore a side of Québec City that most tourists miss. With our certified guide leading the way, you’ll uncover local history, culture, and fascinating stories while enjoying the thrill of a smooth and fun scooter ride. Stop by the historic l'Anse à Cartier, visit the bustling Grand-Marché de Québec, and get a real taste of life in Québec City, all while soaking in stunning views and unforgettable moments

***Must be 14 or over to enjoy this experience***
